# soapysdr-module-mirisdr

**SoapySDR driver module for Mirics hardware**

- **Version recorded:** 0.2.5
- **Categories:** `hardware`, `sdr`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/pothosware/SoapySDR/wiki>

## What it does

A plugin for SoapySDR, the vendor-neutral SDR abstraction layer, that makes Mirics-based receivers including SDRplay RSP under the open driver usable through the generic SoapySDR interface.

## Why you would want it

It is what lets one program drive many different radios. Software written against SoapySDR — CubicSDR, SDR++, GQRX, gr-osmosdr and a great deal else — reaches Mirics hardware through this module rather than through a Mirics-specific code path, so installing it is usually the difference between an application listing your radio and showing an empty device list.

## Before it will work

The underlying Mirics library and udev rules — see the `sdrplay-rsp` entry in the hardware catalog — plus SoapySDR itself, which apt pulls in.

## How it installs

- apt: `soapysdr-module-mirisdr`

## Known problems

A SoapySDR module and its underlying library are versioned together and a mismatch shows up as a device that is not listed rather than as an error. `SoapySDRUtil --info` reports which modules loaded and is the first thing to check when a radio is invisible.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade
